recipes.step_context: PROPOSED: "Did you complete an exploration-preparation sequence this morning?" (5-min novel microdomain exposure, e.g. unfamiliar pattern, new vocabulary set, novel motor sequence)
recipes.baseline_control: explicit-No mornings (no sequence) on comparable wake-days (matched prior sleep, weekday, training load)
recipes.disconfirming_result: with >=5 prep and >=5 explicit-No days, >=70% coverage, primary effect <= 0 or Welch p >= 0.05. Below coverage -> inconclusive.
recipes.exposure_input_basis: user answers Journal question about preparation sequence

recipes.step_context: PROPOSED: "Did you complete the standardized encoding block today?" (fixed 10-min study of assigned novel material, same for all conditions)
recipes.baseline_control: not a contrast -- this is the held-constant step. Control is the absence of A1/A3/A4, not absence of encoding.
recipes.disconfirming_result: if immediate accuracy differs across arms by >5 pp or p < 0.05, encoding standardization failed -> entire protocol inconclusive.
recipes.exposure_input_basis: external producer records encoding block completion

recipes.step_context: PROPOSED: "Did you keep a 60-min quiet wake window after encoding?" (no media, no tasks, eyes-open rest or breath protocol only)
recipes.baseline_control: explicit-No days (no quiet window) on comparable wake-days; interference arm = matched disruption (notifications, secondary task)
recipes.disconfirming_result: quiet - interference <= 0 on primary at >=70% coverage, Welch p >= 0.05.
recipes.exposure_input_basis: user answers Journal question about quiet wake window

recipes.step_context: PROPOSED: "Did you sleep >=7 h with no alarm?" (natural wake, no intentional restriction)
recipes.baseline_control: explicit-No nights (<7 h or alarm) on comparable nights; season/DST boundary = stop
recipes.disconfirming_result: natural - restricted <= 0 at >=70% coverage, Welch p >= 0.05. Carry-over check at lag 14: if lag-14 > lag-7, result inconclusive.
recipes.exposure_input_basis: WHOOP/HealthKit sleep duration and alarm flag

recipes.step_context: PROPOSED: "Did you do a 5-min re-exposure (not re-study) on day 3?" (brief cued recall, no feedback)
recipes.baseline_control: explicit-No days (no re-exposure) on comparable wake-days
recipes.disconfirming_result: re-exposure - no <= 0 at >=70% coverage, Welch p >= 0.05.

recipes.step_context: Full sequence (A1->A2->A3->A4->A5) vs Neutral sequence (A2 only, no A1/A3/A4/A5)
recipes.baseline_control: Neutral = explicit-No on A1, A3, A4, A5 on same wake-day; encoding (A2) held constant
recipes.disconfirming_result: CORE FALSIFICATION: full sequence - neutral <= 0 on primary at >=70% coverage, Welch p >= 0.05. Any single component (A1, A3, A4, A5) null/harm also falsifies its individual claim. Below coverage -> inconclusive.
recipes.exposure_input_basis: A1 self_report, A2 device_measured, A3 self_report, A4 imported_source, A5 device_measured

falsification_criteria.criterion: Primary endpoint null or harm in within-person A/B (full sequence vs neutral) with adequate coverage (>=5 per arm, >=70%)
falsification_criteria.meaning: The core claim -- that the state sequence increases 7-day far transfer per learning minute -- is not supported. Stop building the annealing engine.

falsification_criteria.criterion: Any single component (A1, A3, A4, A5) shows null/harm on its individual contrast at adequate coverage
falsification_criteria.meaning: The sequence is not additive; the hypothesized phase (explore, consolidate, sleep, re-expose) does not contribute. Reallocate to the next exploration.

falsification_criteria.criterion: Immediate encoding differs across arms (manipulation check fails: >5 pp or p < 0.05 on learning.immediate.accuracy)
falsification_criteria.meaning: The 'focused encoding standardized in all arms' assumption is violated. The comparison is confounded. Protocol inconclusive -- redesign encoding standardization.

falsification_criteria.criterion: Carry-over dominates (lag-14 effect > lag-7 effect on primary, or lag-2 > lag-1 on sleep)
falsification_criteria.meaning: The effect is not consolidation but residual interference or delayed expression. Result inconclusive for consolidation claim.

falsification_criteria.criterion: Expectancy/placebo explains the effect (baseline self_report expectancy covariate renders primary effect <= 0 at p >= 0.05)
falsification_criteria.meaning: The benefit is belief-mediated, not state-sequence-mediated. The 'belief/placebo route to willpower' (per #79 comment) is the active ingredient -- redirect to that hypothesis.

falsification_criteria.criterion: Missingness / censoring asymmetric (coverage <70% in one arm, or censoring pattern predicts outcome)
falsification_criteria.meaning: The comparison is not fair. The trial is censored, not failed -- documented as inconclusive per #85.

non_falsifiable_acknowledged: If the study cannot be run (no physical device for external learning producer, no consent, EEG/WHOOP export unavailable, external producer API changes), the result is inconclusive -- not evidence for or against. The design documents this as a censored trial.

self_report and agent_inferred tiers are never promoted to primary learning outcomes (enforced by #77 receipt logic). A null result on primary with only self-report data is expected, not a falsification of the protocol.

not_executed.reason: Requires external learning producer (Anki/FSRS, custom microdomain) with hold-out novel-task transfer test. NOOP has no learning engine.
not_executed.how_measured: kvnloo/anki, kvnloo/fsrs4anki, or custom microdomain tooling emits #77 ExternalOutcomeObservation with outcome_key = learning.far_transfer.7d_per_min, input_tier = device_measured, measurement_protocol = far_transfer_test_vX.Y.Z
Same as above with respective outcome_keys

not_executed.reason: Requires EEG hardware + consent; not a NOOP sensor.
not_executed.how_measured: Optional external probe; input_tier = device_measured, source_id = eeg_research_probe, recorded as context only (never primary)

not_executed.item: optional external research probes (EEG, virtual-reality, eye_movement, stroboscopic)
not_executed.reason: Optional external research probes; not NOOP capabilities.
not_executed.how_measured: Same as EEG -- context only, input_tier = device_measured, never assigned exposure

not_executed.reason: User-entered; NOOP records it but cannot validate it as a learning outcome.
not_executed.how_measured: Journal question PROPOSED: 'How confident are you that today's preparation will help?' (1-7); recorded as context covariate only

not_executed.reason: Agent inference; explicitly barred from primary outcomes per #79 comment.
not_executed.how_measured: If an agent infers attention from telemetry, it is logged with input_tier = agent_inferred, input_basis = '...', used only as secondary context

not_executed.reason: Pure type cannot prove lock-before-exposure; needs independent persistence (signed hash, write-once log, external timestamping).
not_executed.how_measured: Documented as NOT_EXECUTED -- the #76 contract design notes this; a real implementation would need an external timestamping service or local write-once log

exit_criteria.criterion: Two-workflow evidence (M2+). Two independent genuine user workflows not expressible losslessly through current NOOP primitives demonstrated and recorded in #79.
Invariant repaired on main (M3). #76 §4 violation (explicit-No baseline) fixed on both platforms with synthetic vectors and oracle parity.
Locked contract + adjudicated receipt. #76 contract locked before day 1; #77 receipt with verdict from predeclared rule.
Falsification plan executed. At least one F-criterion tested with adequate coverage and result recorded.
Input tier invariant enforced. No self_report or agent_inferred in primary learning outcome fields in any receipt.
Fork gates on exact head. gate isolate then gate union on throwaway ref. BLOCKED/NOT_EXECUTED recorded as such.
Human burden stated and bounded. 0 new minutes/day (reuses existing Journal questions; Breathe opt-in, default OFF).
Stop date: 2026-11-21. If G1 not collected, exploration dropped or re-scoped; result kept.
